bounded_finding_titles.M2-B37: subreaper acquisition failure did not stop the launch path before fork()
bounded_finding_titles.M2-B38: a fork() that failed after acquisition left the ownership state active
bounded_finding_titles.M2-B39: restoration reported RESTORED while its own readback disagreed
bounded_finding_titles.M2-B40: abort stages started fresh fixed waits after the global deadline was exhausted

known_limitations: The first delegated qualification of this closure ran all 303 tests of the previous revision with zero skips and failed two; both are diagnosed under delegated_qualification_findings, both are closed, and the modified worktree was then re-qualified with all 309 tests passing and zero skips.  The failing transcript is preserved rather than discarded.
The delegated physical qualification of this closure has not been performed; the operator command is recorded and nothing physical is claimed until its transcript replaces the delegated_run object.

The acquisition gate is fail-closed: a kernel that does not implement PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, or a policy that refuses it, now refuses the whole effect rather than proceeding without proved ownership.  This is intentional and is the closure of M2-B37, but it is a behaviour change for such a host and is disclosed rather than hidden.

PrivateMountHelper.close() now spends one bound rather than a cooperative bound plus a fresh reap bound, so its worst case fell from roughly ten seconds to five.  A caller that supplies a deadline shorter than the cooperative prefix may reach the forced kill-and-reap with no time left; that outcome is reported truthfully as reaped=false rather than waited past the caller's bound.

While a trusted helper is alive this controller is a child subreaper.  An orphaned descendant of this controller that no effect owns would reparent here and is not reaped, because reaping it would require waitpid(-1) and could consume an unrelated child.  The window is bounded by helper lifetime and is disclosed rather than closed.

A DeprecationWarning about fork() in a multi-threaded process is emitted when the trusted mount-namespace helper is forked.  It is pre-existing, non-failing, not introduced by this closure, and is NOT closed here.
EVID-08 remains IMPLEMENTED: the retry counter belongs to the Milestone 3 cumulative budgets.
Milestone 3 remains forbidden and was not started.

delegated_run.detail: The operator ran the four qualification modules inside a transient Delegate=yes systemd unit under ADMISSIBLE_REQUIRE_DELEGATED_CGROUP=1, against the worktree carrying the B37, B38, B39 and B40 changes and the two repairs the first delegated run demanded.  Zero skips: under that variable a delegated test fails rather than skipping, so no result here can be a false green.

non_blocking_observations.disposition: Recorded truthfully as an existing non-blocking observation.  It appeared in the non-privileged regression as well, it is not introduced by this closure, it failed no test, and it is NOT claimed closed here.
non_blocking_observations.observation: DeprecationWarning: This process is multi-threaded, use of fork() may lead to deadlocks in the child.

m2_subreaper_deadline_closure.operator_command:
cd /home/stris/work/agent-os-capsule-integration && \
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "paired-runner/m2-subreaper-deadline-closure" && \
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c30bf3d38445f59271b61ad4db8520ed053af281" && \
sudo systemd-run --quiet --wait --collect --pipe \
  --unit="admissible-m2-subreaper-deadline-qualification-$$" \
  --property="User=$USER" \
  --property="Group=$(id -gn)" \
  --property=Delegate=yes \
  --property=TasksMax=infinity \
  --working-directory=/home/stris/work/agent-os-capsule-integration \
  --setenv=PYTHONPATH=/home/stris/work/agent-os-capsule-integration \
  --setenv=ADMISSIBLE_REQUIRE_DELEGATED_CGROUP=1 \
  /usr/bin/python3 -m unittest -v \
  tests.test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_b25_cgroup_topology \
  tests.test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_b25_final_failclosed \
  tests.test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_final_protocol_lifecycle \
  tests.test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_subreaper_deadline_closure

prior_physical_qualification.scope: This transcript is historical evidence for the code as it stood at the starting commit, where it qualified the B32/B33/B34/B35/M36 closure.  It does not qualify the code changed by this repair; a prior physical transcript never qualifies modified code.

supersedes_prior_current_report.no_second_snapshot_file: The M2-M36 model keeps exactly one current validation report.  The fourth-repair snapshot exists as a file because its bytes were otherwise unreachable; these bytes are reachable from git and from the immutable closure report, so no third file is created.
supersedes_prior_current_report.preserved_in: the git object at the starting commit, and -- in full -- in the immutable implementation/M2_FINAL_PROTOCOL_LIFECYCLE_REPAIR_REPORT.json, which carries every claim the superseded report made about its own closure.
supersedes_prior_current_report.reason: The superseded report was the current artifact for the protocol/lifecycle closure.  This closure changes the code that transcript qualified, so its delegated run moves to prior_physical_qualification with qualifies_this_repair=false rather than staying beside unqualified modified code.  One current artifact must not assert a physical qualification and its absence.

supersedes_validation_report.model: Option A -- versioned historical snapshot.  The superseded bytes are preserved under a clearly historical filename and the canonical filename carries the single current report, so a third party never has to decide which of two files is authoritative.
supersedes_validation_report.reason: M2-M36.  The superseded report carried the fourth-repair terminal refusal, a limitation declaring M2-B25 implemented but not physically qualified, cgroup delegation recorded as unavailable, and real delegated qualification recorded as false -- alongside two B25 closure objects recording a 125-test delegated run that had in fact succeeded.  One current artifact therefore asserted a physical qualification and its absence.  The bytes are preserved unchanged under the historical filename and this file is the sole current report.

test_counts.note: Counts are live discovery totals on the non-privileged development host.  The skipped count is exactly the delegated physical tests plus one legacy delegated test; under ADMISSIBLE_REQUIRE_DELEGATED_CGROUP=1 those tests fail rather than skip.
